title: The Colony of the Rust Belt
author: Ines Kavanagh
blurb: Marguerite Vane, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
